items.name: Jordan P.
items.text: The ribeye alone is worth the trip. Quiet room, sharp service, and a wine list that does not try too hard.

items.name: Aisha M.
items.text: Booked for anniversary. Every course felt considered. The pappardelle was the best pasta I have had in the city.

items.name: Chris L.
items.text: Small menu, big flavors. Waited twenty minutes for a walk-in on Friday — totally fine for food this good.

items.name: Priya S.
items.text: Vegan squash bowl was not an afterthought. Staff knew the wines cold. Will be back.
